caption: A soccer ball is punted far down the field, and it lands and bounces near the far end.

sa.check: It travels far down the field.
It lands and bounces near the far end.
The flight is long, reaching the far end of the field.
The punt comes first, then the flight, then the bounce.

pc.expect: The ball follows one high arc, its forward motion carrying it toward the far end.
pc.fail: The ball flies flat; or it hangs at the top; or it changes direction in mid-air with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: It descends steadily after the peak, and on landing it bounces lower than its flight and rolls.
pc.fail: The ball rises again after starting to fall; or it bounces higher than it flew; or it hovers above the grass.

pc.expect: Each bounce is lower than the one before.
pc.fail: A later bounce is higher than the one before it; or the ball stops dead on first contact with no bounce or roll; or it bounces back toward the kicker.

pc.expect: The ball squashes briefly on landing and springs back round, and the grass flattens under it.
pc.fail: The ball stays flat after landing; or it sinks into the ground; or the ground ripples.

pc.expect: One ball is in play throughout.
pc.fail: The ball vanishes in flight or a second one appears; or it turns into another object; or it passes through the ground.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The ball's panels, the field lines and the goal stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour in flight; or the field markings shift between frames; or the goal changes shape.
